subject: English
passage: Five years ago, in a groundbreaking study on urban sustainability, researcher Dr. Bhavana Kamath examined energy consumption patterns across different neighborhoods. The heating systems installed in residential buildings ______ whereas some districts had solar-powered units, others relied on traditional gas furnaces. Remarkably, the areas with newer technology showed thirty percent lower energy costs.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. The convention being tested is punctuation use within a sentence. In this choice, the colon after "widely" is used in a conventional way to introduce the following description of how the heating systems installed in residential buildings varied: whereas some districts had solar-powered units, others relied on traditional gas furnaces.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect because it results in a comma splice. A comma alone cannot be used to join the main clause ("The heating systems...widely") with the subordinate clause and main clause that follow ("whereas...furnaces").
